_instructions: This file holds TPS Digital Services' OWN prices. Every value is null until the user provides real numbers.
Never invent a price to fill a gap: ask the user, then write their answer here so the next offer reuses it.
Nulls are fine to leave in place — only fill the lines the agency actually sells.
When the user gives a price, also set _status to 'configured' and update _last_updated.
Prices are entered excluding tax and in default_currency; convert once, explicitly, when quoting another currency.

retainers_monthly._note: Typical monthly fee per depth of engagement. Tiers map to the Essentiel/Croissance/Performance options in pricing.md.

spend_based._note: Used when the fee is indexed on media budget.

performance_component._note: Percent of INCREMENTAL revenue above an explicitly defined baseline. Always capped — see pricing.md.

unit_rates._note: Per-unit prices for scope lines quoted by volume.

commitment_discounts._note: Discount on the monthly fee in exchange for commitment length. Keep modest — see pricing.md.

terms._note_media_budget_billing: State explicitly whether ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platform or advanced by the agency and re-invoiced — the single most common billing dispute.
